_comment: ngsolve dg_methods#6 (advection makes the DG matrix unsymmetric; CG is the wrong solver). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.2, L2 order 1, SIP diffusion alone vs the same form plus b=(20,0) upwind advection, CG and GMRes both from ngsolve.krylovspace with the same CreateSmoother preconditioner and maxiter 500, reference from the umfpack direct solve. Pure diffusion is symmetric to 4.7e-17 and CG converges in 105 iterations to 2.6e-12. With advection the relative asymmetry is 9.8e-2. CORRECTION: the claim offers two alternative signals and only one occurs. CGSolver raises NOTHING -- no exception, no 'not positive definite' message anywhere in the run. It returns normally after consuming all 500 iterations with a relative error of 208 against the direct solve, i.e. a field two orders of magnitude larger than the answer. An agent guarding on an exception, the first branch the claim names, sees a clean solve and ships the wrong field. GMRes on the same matrix and preconditioner converges in 98 iterations to 2.0e-11. Mutation: dropping the advection terms makes CG converge and the fixture fails on advection_breaks_symmetry and cg_fails_silently_not_loudly.
